paper.title_en: Inhomogeneous Ising model on 2D kagomé lattice: Fermionic field approach
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the two-dimensional inhomogeneous Ising model (2DIM) on the kagomé lattice by mapping it onto a particular non-symmetric eight-vertex model and constructing the corresponding <math altimg="si1.svg" display="inline" id="d1e190"><mi>R</mi></math>-matrix. Using a fermionic representation, we evaluate the partition function and derive explicit expressions for the main thermodynamic quantities. In the thermodynamic limit, we obtain an exact equation for the critical surface determining the phase transition of the model. We also calculate the free energy, specific heat, and spontaneous magnetization in the ferromagnetic case. Furthermore, we show that when one or two coupling constants vanish, the model reduces, respectively, to the square-lattice and one-dimensional Ising models. In both limits, our results reproduce the corresponding exact critical couplings and free energies. •Inhomogeneous 2D Ising model is considered on Kagomé lattice.•Surface of critical couplings is found.•Heat capacity is calculated and presented.•Spontaneous magnetization is calculated and presented.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了二维非均匀Ising模型在kagomé晶格上的精确解，通过费米子场方法构造R矩阵并求得精确临界曲面，属于统计力学和可积模型的深入研究，与广义相对论基础领域有一定关联。
decision.title_zh: 二维kagomé晶格上的非均匀Ising模型：费米子场方法
decision.abstract_zh: 我们通过将二维非均匀Ising模型(2DIM)映射到一个特定的非对称八顶点模型并构造相应的R矩阵，研究了kagomé晶格上的该模型。利用费米子表示，我们计算了配分函数，并推导了主要热力学量的显式表达式。在热力学极限下，我们得到了决定模型相变的临界曲面的精确方程。我们还计算了铁磁情况下的自由能、比热和自发磁化强度。此外，我们证明了当一个或两个耦合常数消失时，模型分别简化为方格和二维Ising模型。在这两种极限下，我们的结果再现了相应的精确临界耦合和自由能。**•**研究了kagomé晶格上的非均匀二维Ising模型。**•**找到了临界耦合曲面。**•**计算并给出了热容量。**•**计算并给出了自发磁化强度。
